servinfo.title: Front Side-Impact Pressure Sensor Inspection (10-Channel Air Bag System)

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Side-Impact Pressure Sensor Removal and Installation (10-Channel Air Bag System)

servinfo.ptxt: Check front side-impact pressure sensor and if any of the following conditions is found, replace it with new one.

item.ptxt: Side-air bag/curtain air bag is deployed.
Sensor for dents, crack or deformation.
Sensor connectors (sensor side and harness side) and sensor connector lock mechanism are damaged or cracked.
Connector terminals are bent, corroded or rusted.
